lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Monday night in Telluride, where Town Council votes on the 2027 budget and property tax levy — and takes a second crack at an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year, a real tension between the town's finances and its land-conservation commitments. The Fire District is also weighing debt financing and a budget second reading on Monday, the School Board debriefs November ballot results that will shape school funding, and Norwood's Planning and Zoning digs into Land Use Code and Master Plan updates that set the rules for what gets built there for years to come.
